ارتشيتم (form VIII)
# اِرْتَشَيْتُمْ (irtašaytum) /ir.ta.ʃaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
# اُرْتُشِيتُمْ (urtušītum) /ur.tu.ʃiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِرْتَشَى (irtašā)
